Par is your average weekly stock used over the four completed weeks before this week, rounded up to whole units or packs. Stock used = opening stock + stock received − closing stock. Record each week in Stock count → Weekly usage. All four weeks must be recorded for an item; enter 0 for a week with no usage.
Usage is calculated automatically: Sunday stock count + all orders placed Sunday to Saturday − the next Sunday stock count. Only this account’s counts and orders are used.

Par is your average usage over the previous four completed Sunday–Saturday weeks, rounded up to whole units or packs. Usage is calculated from Sunday stock + that week’s orders − the next Sunday stock count. Save Sunday counts and place orders as usual; usage updates automatically. Five consecutive Sunday counts are needed for four complete weeks. Missing counts or negative usage need checking.

Par is your average usage over the previous four completed Sunday–Saturday weeks, rounded up to whole units or packs. Usage is calculated from Sunday stock + that week’s orders − the next Sunday stock count. Save Sunday counts and place orders as usual; usage updates automatically. Five consecutive Sunday counts are needed for four complete weeks. Missing counts or negative usage need checking. Recommended order = par − the latest stock count, rounded up to whole units, with a minimum of zero.

Used until the first completed week of usage is available.

Par is your location’s average usage from up to four completed Sunday–Saturday weeks, rounded up to whole units or packs. Usage is calculated from Sunday stock + that week’s orders − the next Sunday stock count. Save Sunday counts and place orders as usual; usage updates automatically. With no completed usage weeks, Head Office can set a manual par in the stock editor for this location. After one completed week, par uses that week, then averages two, three and finally four available completed weeks. Missing counts or negative usage need checking; they are excluded. Recommended order = par − the latest stock count, rounded up to whole units, with a minimum of zero.
